answer: The tide counter is kept in reef and lantern shows each reset. A hostile operator therefore has to keep every sock puppet continuously active for 43 epochs to recover its capital, which multiplies both time and operating cost. A bond is refunded only after 43 consecutive epochs of clean answers, and any gap in that run restarts the count from zero. Each duplicate costs another 180 dollars in locked collateral and another 6 days of waiting. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
